question: Should OpenClaw officially support Android/Termux as a Gateway host, and if so which lifecycle, auth, dashboard exposure, update, and real-device validation model is supported?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but adding Android Gateway hosting changes platform support, mobile background behavior, network exposure, and security posture beyond a narrow code fix.

options.title: Define scoped Android host mode
options.body: Keep this open while maintainers choose one supported Android/Termux hosting model and require security, lifecycle, docs, and real-device validation before implementation.

options.title: Keep Android node-only
options.body: Resolve the direction by documenting that Android remains a companion node and mobile-only users should use a remote host, SSH/Tailscale path, or clearly unofficial external stack.

options.title: External ecosystem only
options.body: Treat AndroidForClaw/HermesApp-style full-device hosting as external ecosystem work unless it identifies a missing OpenClaw core API.

recommendation.title: Define scoped Android host mode
recommendation.body: Keep this open while maintainers choose one supported Android/Termux hosting model and require security, lifecycle, docs, and real-device validation before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans project direction, Gateway service lifecycle, Android platform scope, and security posture, and the current code/docs history points to Peter as the cross-cutting owner.
